scam_intelligence.name: CBI/Police Digital Arrest
patterns: Involvement in money laundering linked to your Aadhaar
Demanding you stay on a video call without hanging up
Fake arrest warrants shown over WhatsApp
Isolation from family: 'Do not tell anyone, this is secret'
scripts: Aapka Aadhaar card ek illegal parcel mein mila hai.
Aapko abhi digital custody mein liya ja raha hai.
Phone mat katiye, warna police aapke ghar pahunch jayegi.

scam_intelligence.name: Bank/PAN KYC Update Scam
patterns: Urgent timeline: 'Account will block in 24 hours'
Request to click on bit.ly or tinyurl links
Impersonation of leading banks (SBI, HDFC, ICICI)
scripts: Dear Customer, your HDFC bank account KYC has expired. Please update immediately via link.
Namma bank KYC expire agide, dayavittu ee link click madi update madi.

scam_intelligence.name: Electricity Disconnection Scam
patterns: Request to call a 'personal' officer number
Minimal amount collection (₹10-100) to gain remote access
scripts: Aapka bijli ka bill update nahi hai. Aaj raat line kaat di jayegi.
Power Department: Transaction failed. Call 98XXXXXX immediately.
